explanation: This fires only at D1 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 onward) when the agent has been choosing a2 for a while and the previous trial was unrewarded right after a rewarded one (a single, fresh loss), reaching about 10 there (only about 2 around trial 90). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, on every rewarded D1, after a second loss in a row, when the agent has been choosing a1, and at any point earlier in the episode.
